inventory.anchor: UNIFIED_SOURCES of dom/base/test/gtest (TestStealthStackFrames.cpp, after the lines of the other folders)
inventory.notes: Registers the gtest TestStealthStackFrames.cpp: a stack string a page reads has no frame of Juggler's scripts.

Page-observable: frames whose source starts with the Juggler resource path are dropped from every stack string built for content. The filter is a URL prefix, so it breaks silently if Juggler's resource path changes; juggler/moz.build is the owner of that path. The frame-skip (frame = nextFrame, skippedAsync, continue) must stay inside Mozilla's walk loop; only the source-prefix test (about 15 lines) can move to our file behind a bool-returning call.
